_readme:
ALL text on the site lives here, in English (en) and Chinese (zh). Nothing is rendered from HTML - every string is drawn into a canvas by the GPU - so this file is the only place to edit wording, and it is the only readable copy that exists. The build XORs and base64s it into the bundle and prunes the keys below, so none of this ships as text. Keep both languages filled: the toggle is a cut between them and a missing value leaves a hole on screen. Do not rename keys. Plain text only - no HTML tags, no
: line breaks are decided by the layout engine. Opening runs carry no terminal punctuation - a page that states does not narrate. An entry marked "placeholder": true is a real thing with a fact still missing; read its "note", fill the value in, then delete both keys. A blank "year" or "url" is drawn as the hollow square, and an open-ended year simply ends on its en dash - the page shows where the fact will go rather than hiding that it is missing. _readme, note and placeholder are stripped at build and never leave the repository. After adding any NEW Chinese character, run `npm run fonts` - the CJK webfonts are subset to exactly the characters this file uses.

prose.en: I am an AI policy researcher and political strategist based in Berlin. I focus on technologies with disruptive social impacts and on building the alliances, resources and institutional capacity needed to govern them. My work centres on systemic analysis, focusing on the geopolitics of AI across China, the United States and the European Union.
prose.zh: 我是一名常驻柏林的人工智能政策研究者与政治战略顾问，关注具有颠覆性社会影响的技术，并致力于构建治理这些技术所需的联盟、资源与机构能力。我的工作以系统性分析为核心，包括人工智能在中国、美国和欧盟之间的地缘政治维度。

prose.en: Embedded in civil society and labour movements, I ground my advisory work in the experience of global networks responding to the challenges posed by AI and Big Tech. Drawing on industry experience in machine learning and work as an AI policy fellow focused on technology diplomacy, I bring a multilateral, systemic lens to how technological risks and impacts unfold.
prose.zh: 扎根于公民社会与劳工运动，我通过应对人工智能与大型科技公司挑战的全球网络，让咨询工作建立在一线现实之上。凭借机器学习行业经验，以及专注于技术外交的人工智能政策研究经历，我以多边和系统性视角审视技术风险与影响如何在现实中展开。

title.en: Ontological Insecurity: Sovereignty, Nationalism and How the EU Navigates China-US Competition for AI Market Dominance
title.zh: 本体性不安全：主权、民族主义，以及欧盟如何在中美争夺人工智能市场主导权的竞争中寻路

description.en: This working paper analyses how emerging sovereignty narratives around technological infrastructure and AI reflect geopolitical insecurity as market power concentrates within China-US competition. As nationalism and defence concerns intensify across Europe, sovereignty becomes a strategy for regaining security. Drawing on theories and frameworks grounded in social movements across the Global South, the paper offers guidance on how institutions and movements can build the capabilities and infrastructure needed to protect the public interest.
description.zh: 本工作论文分析了围绕技术基础设施和人工智能兴起的主权叙事，如何反映市场力量集中于中美竞争格局所引发的地缘政治不安全感。随着民族主义和国防关切在欧洲加剧，主权成为重获安全感的一种战略。论文借鉴植根于全球南方社会运动的理论与框架，为机构和社会运动如何建设保护公共利益所需的能力与基础设施提供建议。

title.en: Artificial Intelligence in Nuclear Regulatory Frameworks: Trends in Security Narratives and Regulatory Change
title.zh: 核监管框架中的人工智能：安全叙事与监管变革的趋势

description.en: This briefing examines how artificial intelligence has become a prominent issue in traditional international security domains such as arms control. It maps the actors, incentives and trends driving this shift and considers what they mean for security policy in a rapidly changing regulatory environment.
description.zh: 本简报考察人工智能如何成为军备控制等传统国际安全领域的重要议题，梳理推动这一转变的参与者、动机与趋势，并探讨这些趋势在快速变化的监管环境中对安全政策的意义。
